## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is about one change
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, at about the coverage the file already has
- [ ] `pytest -p no:respx`, `ruff check` and `mypy` pass on my changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for it under the current in-progress section
- [ ] No issue or ticket numbers in source comments, docstrings or log strings

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-request-guidelines) for the details behind each point.
